name: luh-reference-vibration-measurements-of-mensa-bridge-hannover
notes: The Mensa bridge in Hannover, Germany is a footbridge crossing the street Schneiderberg and connects the universites' canteen and the park. The dataset contains measurments of the vertical and the horizontal accererations of the bridge deck under ambient excitation (e.g. wind and pedestrians) and impuls excitation. The impuls excitations have been realized using a modal hammer. The impuls has been applied at six diffent positions, three times in vertical direction (DSV) and three times in horizontal direction (DSH) near the sensor that is indicated in the filename.
title: Reference Vibration Measurement of Mensa Bridge Hannover

resources.description: This is the measurement data of a vibration measurement. The CSV file contains the time series measurements of piezoelectric accelerometers placed at different positions at the bridge deck in horizontal directions (DSH1, DSH2 and DSH3) and vertical direction (DSV1 - DSV7). The first column in the file represents the time in seconds. The sampling rate is 2000 Hz. The accelerations are measured in meter per square second. The measurement directions are for accelerometer DSV1 to DSV5 in Z direction vertical to the ground, DSV6 and DSV6 are in -Z direction vertical to the top. For sensors DSH1 to DSH3 the measurement direction is in Y direction horizontal and orthogonal to the bridge' longitudinal axis. The vibration was excited by wind and pedestrians that walked on the bridge during the measurement (ambiant).
resources.name: 20180424_Ambient.csv
